item.title: [LU-20487] Kernel panic in mdt_getxattr() during striped directory deletion
item.description:

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
This issue happened because a race condition occurred: object was acceptable to the request path, but LOHA_EXISTS was clear when  mdt_getxattr()  ran. With TCU + striped parent in LU-20305, this is especially likely for virtual STCU FIDs.

BTW, I can reproduce this issue on arm rocky9.6 kernel 100%, but can't on rocky8.10.

"Emoly Liu <emoly@whamcloud.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/67326
Subject: LU-20487 tcu: allow getxattr on virtual STCU objects
